map.→ 打开遗物测量记录工具: -> Open the artefact measurement record tool
map.不规则遗物（如石器、骨器）优先用排水法测真体积；陶片、残器可用长×宽×厚近似，但: For irregular artefacts (stone tools, bone tools), use water displacement to get the true volume; for sherds and fragments, length x width x thickness is an approximation and the record must note that it is an estimate. Density is only an auxiliary discriminator (for example sand-tempered pottery tends to be lighter and clay-bodied pottery heavier) and cannot date an object on its own.
map.体积用排水法还是尺寸估算？: Should volume use water displacement or dimension estimates?
map.区分完整器与残断器：残器只记可见最大尺寸，并标注残断，避免与完整器形制指数混算。: Distinguish complete vessels from fragments: for a fragment record only the largest visible dimensions and mark it as broken, so it is not mixed into the typological index of complete vessels.
map.按考古测量规范记录遗物尺寸、重量，自动计算体积、密度与形制指数并生成标准记录条目: Record artefact dimensions and weight following archaeological measurement conventions, automatically computing volume, density and typological index and generating a standard record entry
map.整理出土遗物清单前，用形制指数（长宽比、厚长比）批量区分饼、罐、钵等器类，辅助类: Before sorting the excavated artefact list, use typological indices (length-to-width ratio, thickness-to-length ratio) to separate vessel classes such as bowls, jars and bowls in bulk, aiding typological grouping.
map.田野出土陶片、石器、骨器等遗物登记时，按考古测量规范录入三维尺寸（长×宽×厚）与: When registering excavated artefacts such as pottery sherds, stone tools and bone tools, enter the three-dimensional dimensions (length x width x thickness) and weight following archaeological measurement conventions, and the volume and density are converted automatically into a standard record entry.
map.田野记录一般统一用厘米（cm）或毫米（mm），不足 1cm 用 mm 记到整数；: Field records normally use centimetres (cm) or millimetres (mm) consistently; anything under 1 cm is recorded in mm to a whole number; weight is in grams (g). Units must be consistent within a site, and the zero of the callipers and the electronic scale should be calibrated before entry.
map.遗物密度（件/平方米）统计: Artefact density (items per square metre) statistics
map.遗物尺寸按什么单位记录？: In what units are artefact dimensions recorded?
map.：测得长 18.5cm、宽 12.0cm、厚（腹径方向）9.0cm，重量 145: : the measured dimensions are 18.5 cm long, 12.0 cm wide, 9.0 cm thick (belly direction) and 1450 g. Approximating the volume as a rectangular block gives 18.5 x 12.0 x 9.0 = 1998 cm3, so the density = 1450/1998, about 0.73 g/cm3, which falls in the common range for sand-tempered pottery (0.6-1.4 g/cm3).
